threads.body: this is no longer used by jmx-scraper
get the metric names from yaml to allow filtering on metric names.
split the parsing and the registration as we need to be able to get the list of metric names that have been parsed.
metric names from handlers are only available after instances have been created.

as the metric names are registered dynamically by handlers, we need to make them explicitly provide the list. This is technically a breaking change, providing a default implementation with an empty list would only create a silent failure, so probably better for now to produce a compile-time error (alternatively we can issue a warning if that's better).
make this method only do the parsing, let the caller handle the registration.

threads.body: When two providers share a handler name, the registry keeps only the first provider but still reports metric names from the discarded provider. Callers of `load()` can therefore register names for metrics that the selected handler cannot produce. Add names only when the handler is accepted.

This returns only the YAML extractor metrics, not the metrics that the handlers on this `MetricDef` produce.

```suggestion
  /**
   * Get metric names included in this MetricDef, does not include metrics from handlers.
   *
   * @return metric names.
   */
```
